physical_gags.presentation: Follow the real split trajectories. Optional caption only if the empty bike continues moving.
physical_gags.do_not: Add a random launch impulse to manufacture distance.

physical_gags.presentation: One small clap, a sideways look from another spectator, then silence.
physical_gags.do_not: Force the bike upright or award the lost rider combo.

physical_gags.presentation: Body follows actual acceleration while boots scramble for support.
physical_gags.do_not: Use a fixed superhero pose for every possible hang.

physical_gags.presentation: Brief jacket straightening before he notices the vehicle.
physical_gags.do_not: Delay the reset button or pretend clothing repairs the crash.

physical_gags.presentation: Let the actual delayed fall end with one small clink. Prefer no dialogue.
physical_gags.do_not: Trigger an unrelated chair collapse with a timer.

physical_gags.presentation: Filmer lowers phone slightly to watch with their eyes.
physical_gags.do_not: Rotate the NPC to react through a wall.

physical_gags.presentation: One incident-report stamp and optional employee line.
physical_gags.do_not: Teleport the vehicle into the bay.

physical_gags.presentation: Tiny glance toward the pegs, then eyes forward.
physical_gags.do_not: Remove boots, equipment, or body parts.

physical_gags.presentation: Single sincere board tap on concrete. No voice or caption needed.
The rider notices it and takes one annoyed step.
physical_gags.do_not: Inject new engine power after the bike has stopped.

physical_gags.presentation: Tiny collar or glove adjustment, otherwise continue riding.
physical_gags.do_not: Take steering away for a victory dance.

physical_gags.presentation: A harmless cosmetic key tag tumbles separately and settles later.
